name: orbit-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics and formatting for the Orbit template language.

orbit.hasProjectHost.markdownDescription:
Report diagnostics that depend on the project's type registry (unknown identifiers, unknown properties).

Off by default: an editor has no way to know a project's object model, so every `{product.title}` would be flagged as an unknown identifier and bury the diagnostics that ARE actionable. Turn this on only when the language server has been given a host description.

orbit.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Orbit language server.
